scene_en: a quiet-luxury master bedroom in a Saudi villa: walls painted warm Antwerp beige, a full-width upholstered headboard wall in soft taupe, a king bed with layered ivory linen bedding, walnut bedside tables with brass-and-white swing-arm wall lamps above them, a boucle bench at the foot of the bed, beige wood-look porcelain floor planks, sheer beige cotton curtains over a large window, soft cove lighting
